comments.author: badrabbit
comments.story_title: The Cult of Sigmund Freud
comments.why_zh: 展示了 Freud 如何影响现代资本主义生活
comments.quote_zh: 前阵子在 HN 上分享的这部纪录片让我大开眼界
comments.text_zh: 我完全不信任任何弗洛伊德式的东西。他提出的每一个重大主张，我都不断发现严重缺陷。Freud 并没有普及无意识，也没有普及对思考方式的思考。连教会里基本的儿童主日学都会讲你如何思考。从基督教到佛教，各大宗教都谈论一个人的思想生活如何影响一切，以及人类分裂且冲突的本性。他们只是不用 conscious 和 unconscious 这类后弗洛伊德术语。Freud 真正普及的，是一种世俗化的方式来应对人类如何思考，在纯世俗语境中分析它，把数千年来关于这个主题的知识当作幼稚的童话，并定义一个框架，让现代世俗世界能够解释人们的行动并作出回应。在社会层面，我见过他的作品带来的可怕影响，从刑事惩罚，到人们试图理解和帮助那些选择作恶的人（最糟糕的例子是儿童强奸犯、校园枪手等等……不是有病，是恶！但在弗洛伊德语境里，恶没有位置）。前阵子在 HN 上分享的这部纪录片让我大开眼界，它展示了现代资本主义生活几乎每个方面都如何受到 Freud 影响：[VIDEO]（Century of the self）。值得把整部看完。我不认为精神分析是彻底的骗术，但我对它非常敌视。任何精神分析式的思考尝试，我都需要用大量批判性分析来过滤，抱着极大的怀疑态度看待！
comments.text: I wholly distrust anything freudian. Every major claim he made I keep finding serious flaws in it. Freud did not popularize the unconscious or thinking about how you think. Basic children's sunday school at a Church even talks about how you think. Major religions from Christianity to Buddhism talk about how the thought life of a person affects everything and the split and conflicted nature of humans. They just don't use post-freudian terms like conscious and unconscious. What freud popularized was a secular way of coping with how humans think, analyzing it in a purely secular context and considering thousands of years of knowledge on the subject as childish fairytales and defining a framework by which a modern secular world can explain the actions of people and respond to them. Socially, I have seen horrific impacts of his work from criminal punishment to people attempting to understand and help people who have chosen to be evil (worst examples being child rapists, school shooters,etc... not sick, evil! But evil has no place in a freudian context). This documentary shared on HN a while back was eye opening for me, how almost every aspect of modern capitalist life was influenced by freud: [VIDEO] (Century of the self). Worth watching the whole thing. I don't discount psychoanalysis as quackery but I am very hostile to it. I would need to filter any attempts of psychoanalytical thinking with a ton if critical analysis, taking it with buckets of salt!

comments.text_zh: 孩子被过度诊断，而父母双方都在公司上班，把他们塞进学校，让他们每天坐上十个小时、闭嘴别动：ADHD——开安非他命类药（Ritalin、Adderall）；性别烦躁——开青春期阻断剂；自闭症谱系——Abilify 和 Risperdal [LINK] [LINK]。青少年和大学生被过度诊断：抑郁症——开 SSRIs；糖尿病——开 Meglitinides；肥胖——开节食处方 [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK]。成年人：男性——2008 年以来的阿片类药物泛滥；女性——中年女性每四人就有一人在服用抗抑郁药；网络成瘾——公司需要提升“engagement”；ADD——通知和 24/7 多任务处理现在成了常态 [LINK]。养老院里的老人：多到列不完。我们需要意识到，这些“流行病”和“发病率上升”更多是资本主义产业与政府联手的结果，而不是个体发病率。他们制造了女对男、黑对白的对立，让人们不去关注真正的原因：[LINK]。Big Tech 是问题的一大部分，许多不健康的习惯和由此产生的抑郁都来自网红产业。在其他人群中，不健康的影响被专门推动和宣传，直到变得正常化。当你年轻、易受影响时，它更容易扎根：Gangsta rap、Drill music——音乐产业，腐蚀黑人青年；Instagram 和 TikTok——网红产业，腐蚀青春期女孩。你看过的大多数卡通，乃至其中的“编程”，都是围绕周边商品机会设计的
comments.text: Kids overdiagnoses, while both parents work in corporations and stick them in a school to sit down and shut up for 10 hours a day: ADHD - prescribe amphetamines (Ritalin, Adderall) Gender Dysphoria - prescribe hormone blockers Autism spectrum - Abilify and Risperdal [LINK] [LINK] Teenager and College Student overdiagnoses: Depression - prescribe SSRIs Diabetes - prescribe Meglitinides Obesity - prescribe diets [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] Adults: Men - Opioid epidemic since 2008 Women - One in four on antidepressants in middle age Internet Addiction - companies need to boost "engagement" ADD - notifications and multitasking 24/7 is normal now [LINK] Elderly in nursing homes: Too many to list We need to realize that these "epidemics" and "rises in incidence" have more to do with the capitalist industry and government working together, than individual incidence. comments.author: Bender
comments.story_title: There's No Reason to Fear an Invasion of Chinese Electric Vehicles
comments.why_zh: 用于说明消费决策受情绪驱动
comments.quote_zh: 参见纪录片 Century of the Self……
comments.text_zh: 没有理由害怕中国电动汽车的入侵。恐惧是一种情绪。人们不必基于情绪做购买决定。参见纪录片 Century of the Self…… [1] 我会考虑这样一些逻辑问题：谁来修我的车、我去哪里买零件、零件能供应多久，以及这东西到底有多安全。也许对于更便宜的中国进口电动车来说，这些问题都已经有答案了，但我还没在任何地方看到有人以令人信服的详细程度把这些说清楚，尤其是考虑到当前中美之间的紧张关系。我常听到的回答是“但电动车更简单”，这告诉我，这些人其实并没有真正试着修过一辆。它们根本不简单，零件也相当特殊，而且必须从中国订购。先在美国建好工厂，并先备齐所有零件。给我看美国测试的碰撞安全数据，去掉所有 drive-by-wire 的乱七八糟设计，让电池包可由用户自行维护，去掉所有 dial-home telemetry，也许我们还能谈；否则在我看来，这些就是未来会淹没垃圾填埋场的一次性玩具。[1] - [VIDEO] [video][4 hours][b&w documentary]
comments.text: There's No Reason to Fear an Invasion of Chinese Electric Vehicles Fear is an emotion. People need not make purchasing decisions based on emotions. See documentary Century of the Self... [1] I consider logic such as who is going to repair my vehicle and where am I going to get parts , how long will parts be available and how safe is this thing . Perhaps these are answered questions for the cheaper EV imports but I have not seen this articulated anywhere in a confidence inspiring level of detail especially given the current tension between China and the US. The common answer I hear is "but EV's are simpler" which tells me these people have not actually tried to work on one. They are not simple at all and the parts are quite unique and have to be ordered from China . Build out factories in the US and stock up on all the parts first. Show me the USA tested crash safety data, remove all the drive-by-wire nonsense, make the battery packs user serviceable, remove all dial-home telemetry and maybe we can talk otherwise I see this as future throw-away toys that will flood the landfills. [1] - [VIDEO] [video][4 hours][b&w documentary]
